capabilities: import any public LighterPack list via its share link
create folders per packing-list category and one note per item
generate a summary note with totals, category breakdowns, and a pie chart
store lists locally as Markdown for offline linking, search, and editing
extras: Pending submission to the community plugin browser; manual installation only for now. Requires Obsidian v1.9.10 or newer; internet access only during import.
problem: LighterPack lists live on a website, so gear lists cannot be searched, linked, edited, or read offline inside Obsidian.

relations.evidence: Dataview — used to dinamically display totals summary table
Charts — required to render the pie chart in the summary note

summary: Imports public LighterPack packing lists into a vault folder of Markdown notes, with a summary page showing totals and a weight distribution chart.
